Name: Always Open - Shops and Houses Anytime
Author: Field028
Description:
[size=5][b][color=#e8913a]Description[/color][/b][/size]
Tired of walking to a shop at 6:10pm and finding the door locked? Always Open lets you enter shops and villagers' houses at any hour, on any day, and buy from shops even when the owner has wandered off. Story locks (things that open through events or keys) are left exactly as the game intends.
[line]
[size=5][b][color=#e8913a]Installation instructions[/color][/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*]Install the latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url].[/*]
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into Stardew Valley/Mods (or install it with Vortex).[/*]
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.[/*]
[/list][line]
[size=5][b][color=#e8913a]Main features[/color][/b][/size]

[size=4][b][color=#f7c548]Doors open any time[/color][/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Shops, houses and the Adventurer's Guild open at any hour.[/*]
[*]Also on weekly closing days (like Pierre's Wednesday) and festival days.[/*]
[*]Shops and market stalls added by other mods (like Visit Mount Vapius and East Scarp) can be used at any hour too, on the days they're open.[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b][color=#f7c548]Shops without the owner[/color][/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Pierre, Gus, Willy, Sandy, Harvey, Krobus and other counters open their shop even when the owner isn't standing there.[/*]
[*]Robin, Clint and Marnie show their usual menu (Shop, Upgrade, Construct, Geodes, Animals...) even when they're away.[/*]
[*]Pick up a finished tool upgrade from Clint's counter even when he isn't in the shop.[/*]
[*]Shops that aren't open that day or that season (like seasonal stands or market-day stalls) stay closed.[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b][color=#f7c548]Bedrooms (optional)[/color][/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Enter villagers' bedrooms without needing 2 hearts.[/*]
[*]Nothing is saved to your file: remove the mod and the normal rules come back.[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b][color=#f7c548]Story locks stay[/color][/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Places that unlock through events, quests or keys (like the sewer or the Wizard's tower) are not touched.[/*]
[/list][line]
[size=5][b][color=#e8913a]Requirements[/color][/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Stardew Valley 1.6.15[/*]
[*]SMAPI 4.0.0 or later[/*]
[/list][line]
[size=5][b][color=#e8913a]Compatibility[/color][/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Multiplayer: every player who wants these features needs the mod installed. It works for each player on their own.[/*]
[*]Android: not tested yet. If part of the game is different there, the mod turns off just that part and notes it in the SMAPI log.[/*]
[*]Other mods that change shop hours or let you buy without the owner (like Self Serve) do similar things, so you probably only need one of them.[/*]
[/list][line]
[size=5][b][color=#e8913a]Config[/color][/b][/size]
[list]
[*]config.json is created after the first run.[/*]
[*]IgnoreOpeningHours: doors and shops (including other mods' shops and stalls) open at any time and on any day.[/*]
[*]IgnoreFriendshipLocks: bedrooms and other friendship-locked doors.[/*]
[*]ShopsWithoutOwner: buy from shops when the owner is away.[/*]
[/list][line]
[size=5][b][color=#e8913a]Shout outs[/color][/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Pathoschild for SMAPI and the mod build tools.[/*]
[*]pardeike for Harmony.[/*]
[*]The Stardew Valley Wiki.[/*]
[/list]
